nodes.label: Action and Identity Color Separation
nodes.rationale: Near-black ink is reserved for actions while cyan is reserved for identity, charts, statistics, and evidence so both signals remain distinct.

nodes.label: Flat Visual Hierarchy System
nodes.rationale: Surface tint, hairlines, radius, and saturated brand blocks establish hierarchy without shadows, preserving a fast and friendly visual character.

nodes.label: Editorial and UI Typography Separation
nodes.rationale: Pretendard communicates editorial content while imweb Sans distinguishes interactive controls and product chrome.

nodes.label: Customer Brand as Hero
nodes.rationale: Monochrome platform chrome prevents the product brand from competing with customer sites and templates, which provide the primary visual texture.

nodes.norm_label: block markdown editor and page engine

nodes.label: Domain-based Vertical Slice Delivery
nodes.rationale: Each owner carries a domain feature through UI, API, database, permissions, error handling, and tests to avoid artificial frontend/backend handoffs.

nodes.label: Development Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: A WBS item is complete only when the feature is connected end-to-end, tested, validated by lint/type/build/migrations, documented at extension boundaries, and reviewed by its developer.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Project Manager, Showcase, and PDF Viewer
nodes.norm_label: phase 4 project manager, showcase, and pdf viewer

nodes.label: Open-source Core Integration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Validated engines such as TipTap or Lexical, Yjs, Pdf.js, and Meilisearch should be wrapped and extended instead of reimplemented, reducing schedule and correctness risk.

nodes.label: Component-centered Reuse Strategy
nodes.rationale: Complex layouts should wrap proven UI components and share a design system and state-management rules to reduce implementation effort and fragmentation.

nodes.label: Declarative Schema and Code Generation Strategy
nodes.rationale: ORM and API schemas serve as the single source of truth so types, migrations, and clients can be generated consistently and repetitive interface work is reduced.
nodes.norm_label: declarative schema and code generation strategy
